name: Shortfall Forest
description: The Shortfall Forest, known as the ‘Jewel of the South’ within the Republic, boasts majestic trees and verdant undergrowth. Deep within lies the abandoned lair of Huradrin, a dwarven druid who is now one of the kings of Stonelair. This hut is formed by an opening in the roots of a massive ancient tree. Its walls are etched with glowing druidic runes, leading to the underground realm of Undertanares. Lately, the tranquil forest has been overtaken by unrest. Oncepeaceful creatures are now showing aggression. Owlbears, typically reclusive, are attacking travelers on the roads. Ettercaps, previously bound to the forest’s east by druid magic, now wander to assault anyone venturing into the forest. The treants have gone into hiding, and many dryads are exhibiting symptoms of a disease with black marks, which, in its later stages, may turn them into wicked forest hags. The dryads are seeking Stoneoak, the eldest treant, a great archdruid, and Huradrin’s mentor, believing it may have answers. Rumors suggest Stoneoak may be found close to Huradrin’s lair, searching for an ancient secret in the Undertanares. Lumberjacks and rangers have started vanishing, alarming the people of Aeyefall, who depend on the forest. Desperate, they seek aid from the Adventurer’s Guild. Yet, the Eternal Circle’s druids and rangers blame Aeyefall’s inhabitants for the forest’s plight, deterring them with beasts and magic. Tensions are rising as the Circle is also clashing with the Spawners, a sect of the Cult of Shadow Wing. These cultists are erecting shrines to Droggath in hidden caverns in the forest. Their leader, “The Blighter,” a fat undead hill giant with a taste for eating the hearts of his victims, is roaming the forest. Whether they are the cause of the forest’s recent disturbances or are just seizing the opportunity to advance the sinister agenda of their dark master is uncertain.
